name: AI doctor avatar explainer (white-coat presenter breaks a problem into 'layers', product is the fix for the layer nobody treats)
length: 60-120s (plus a 3-min long cut), 1080x1920, avatar head-and-shoulders + 1 PiP insert per layer

shots.visual: AI specialist (lab coat, 40s, warm studio). Fixed top headline in a white pill: "Why your necklace turns your neck green: 3 layers‼️"
shots.audio_text: "If your jewelry turns your skin green, it's not your skin."

shots.visual: PiP top-right: real green-neck close-up (UGC, with permission). Word-by-word captions mid-frame
shots.audio_text: "Layer one is what everyone blames: sweat, perfume, sensitive skin."

shots.visual: PiP: macro of worn plating flaking off a brass base (stock or own lab shot)
shots.audio_text: "Layer two is the real cause: a copper or brass base under plating so thin it wears through in weeks."

shots.visual: PiP: water beading on a PVD-coated piece (REAL LC footage)
shots.audio_text: "Layer three is the one nobody fixes: the bond. PVD fuses gold to steel. It doesn't rub off."

shots.visual: Full-screen real LC b-roll: shower, pool, sleep
shots.audio_text: "That's why ours are waterproof. Shower, swim, sleep in them."

shots.visual: Avatar returns, offer card lower third

prompts.prompt: Write a 90-second explainer for Louise Carter in the "[problem] has 3 layers" structure: layer 1 = what people blame, layer 2 = real cause, layer 3 = what nothing fixes → PVD bond. ≤15 words per sentence, 140 wpm, calm specialist voice. Mark one PiP insert per layer. No medical claims, no credentials.

Pick 4 "specialist" avatars: woman 35 lab coat, man 55 smart casual, woman 60 cardigan, woman 28 scrubs-free studio. 9:16 head-and-shoulders, neutral warm background, eye-line to lens. Upload the same script to each; export 1080x1920.
Stability 50, similarity 75, style 15; "calm, reassuring, slightly slow"; add 0.3s pauses after each "Layer N".
Fixed headline pill top 12%; captions word-by-word mid-frame (white, black stroke, 58px); punch-in zoom 105% every 5s; PiP 35% width top-right with 0.2s pop; end card 2s.

paid_ads.title: Khazanay Pakistan: Clinic presenter in scrubs (orthopedic shoes)
paid_ads.what: A woman in navy scrubs in a clinic corridor: "Let me tell you that you don't need a new body. You just need better support… it's not always an injury… unsupported shoes… plantar fasciitis". 70 s, run as 2 near-identical ads.
paid_ads.how: A specialist look-alike (scrubs, not a named doctor), a reframe sentence first, then cause, then product category. Captions mid-frame.

paid_ads.title: Dr. Lisa Downing: "Men's health researcher" podcast (prostate DHT)
paid_ads.what: "As a men's health researcher, I study why the prostate swells… This is what most men over 40 get wrong about nighttime urination… Block DHT at the source… 3,000 mg cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil with saw palmetto." 54 s. Dr. Lisa Downing page, 1,357 ads.
paid_ads.how: A persona expert title (not "MD"), "what most [avatar] get wrong", the mechanism, the dose, the result.

paid_ads.title: Male Health Tips: Elder "ancient remedy" doctor (men's health, gut-blood-flow claim)
paid_ads.what: A grey-bearded man in a suit vest holds a dropper bottle; captions read "Dr. Sebi exposed how to increase size QUICKLY". Script: "Most men don't realize… It all comes down to blood flow and what's happening in your gut… berberine and sodium alginate…". 41 s, 222 days.
paid_ads.how: An elder-authority avatar, an "ancient remedy" story, one mechanism. Avoid health claims you can't substantiate.

paid_ads.title: Dr. Amina Siddiq, MD: "Dr. Amina Siddiq, MD" long explainer (skin)
paid_ads.what: A hijab-wearing presenter in a lab-coat look with before/after skin inserts: "It all comes back to one thing. Your skin is missing… The part most women never realize. Almost all modern moisturizers make this worse." 289 s.
paid_ads.how: A one-root-cause script: blame the category, name the missing thing, then product. 4-5 min with inserts.

paid_ads.title: Astrid Zeegen: 60-year-old founder quiz talking head (collagen)
paid_ads.what: A woman of 60 to camera: "Quick quiz. Do you know the difference between marine collagen and bovine collagen? …Does that help your skin, your joints or your gut?" 357 s (with a 392 s sibling).
paid_ads.how: An age-matched presenter, a quiz-style A-or-B question, and the answer explains the product range.

paid_ads.title: Resilia · Blood Sugar Wellness: AI lab-coat “scientist” pitches cinnamon 1000 mg + berberine
paid_ads.what: Opens: “to-do-of to be on cinnamon.extract at 1000mg The same daily amount used in clinical studies Paired with 500mg of Burberry HCL I always recommend both pathways together”
paid_ads.how: If you use this format at all, use a real credentialed expert, on camera, disclosed.
paid_ads.dnc: An AI-generated "nutritionist PhD" persona making health claims is deceptive and likely violates platform policy. Do not copy.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Never call the avatar "Dr." or give credentials it does not have: deceptive endorsement.
Avoid: Disclose AI-generated people (Meta AI info label / TikTok AIGC).
Avoid: Keep layer 3 = product; if the product appears before layer 3 the curiosity loop breaks.
Avoid: Use real product macros for every LC shot; AI-rendered jewelry looks wrong and breaks trust.
Avoid: Health brands: run claims through a banned-words list; structure-function wording only.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
